name: btn-cross-arrow
title: Cross Arrow Button
description: A wide blue pill reading Contact me, with a white circle at its right holding a small diagonal arrow. On hover the arrow sweeps up and out while a second one slides in from the lower left.
use: A contact or outbound link wants an arrow affordance and a small lively hover without changing size.
avoid: The arrow motion is trapped in a small circle and easy to miss, and it plays on hover only for touch users.
a11y: The button has real text and keyboard support, but the arrow cross animation plays on hover only. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide pill in a navy-to-indigo gradient, edged in pale blue, with white Contact me text at the left. A white circle near the right end holds a small black arrow pointing up and to the right.
behaves: Hovering lifts the arrow up and right out of its circle while a second arrow rises into view from the lower left, so the two cross for moment. The pill and its label stay still.
customise: The label, gradient, border and both arrow icons are hardcoded; it takes no props, so edits happen in the file.
weight: light: One pill and two SVG arrows moved by CSS transforms.
